say:0:1421501001:0.text: This time, I'm winning it for sure!
say:0:1421501001:0.source_cn: 这次锻魂大赛的冠军我拿定了！

say:0:1421502001:0.text: The Forgemaster Competition is here again...

say:1:1421502002:0.text: I'll make my master proud this year!
say:1:1421502002:0.source_cn: 这次比赛可得给师父长长脸！

say:0:1421503001:0.text: This place is buzzing! What's all the chatter about?
say:0:1421503001:0.source_cn: 这里好热闹，大家在聊什么呀？

say:3:1421504001:1.text: Is there a competition going on here? Are you the champion? That's awesome!
say:3:1421504001:1.source_cn: 这里是举办了什么比赛吗？你是比赛的冠军？好厉害！

say:4:1421504002:2.text: Don't let him fool you! The competition hasn't even started yet! People are just signing up for it.
say:4:1421504002:2.source_cn: 别听他吹了！今年的锻魂大赛还没办呢！报名才刚刚开始！

say:5:1421504003:1.text: I certainly have what it takes to win this competition! This time, I even convinced my retired master to coach me! He nearly won it back in his day!
say:5:1421504003:1.source_cn: 以我的实力拿冠军又不是不可能！而且这次我好不容易请了我...

say:6:1421504004:1.text: With all due respect, your master's not even that great. Anyway, thanks for reminding me to get some pointers from my master...
say:6:1421504004:1.source_cn: 你师父那点手艺有多少是自己的你不清楚？你倒提醒了我，报...

say:7:1421504005:1.text: I'll bring my master's master—and his master too! That should do the trick...
say:7:1421504005:1.source_cn: 那我就把我师父的师父、师父的师父的师父都请过来！我就不信……

say:9:1421504006:1.text: What? Why are the contestants allowed to get help from others?
say:9:1421504006:1.source_cn: 这是什么比赛呀，怎么还能让别人帮忙的！

say:10:1421504007:1.text: You need to be a dwarf to understand this. First of all, passing down smithing skills is an important part of our culture. All of us start as an apprentice, learning from a master.
say:10:1421504007:1.source_cn: 这你就不懂了吧，我们矮人最重视的就是技艺的传承，在成为...

say:11:1421504008:1.text: Whenever we hit a snag at work, the first thing we do is consult our master. After all, craftsmanship is all about learning and collaboration, not working in isolation.
say:11:1421504008:1.source_cn: 干活的时候，遇到什么难题也是第一时间和师父一起研究，毕...

say:13:1421504009:1.text: To put it simply, this competition tests both the contestants and their masters' guidance. When an apprentice wins, the master shares the glory!
say:13:1421504009:1.source_cn: 说白了，锻魂大赛考验的不光是工匠，还有工匠师父的指导水...

say:14:1421504010:1.text: Speaking of which, I'd be lost if I were Vaun. He doesn't even have a master!
say:14:1421504010:1.source_cn: 说到这个，你觉得瓦恩该怎么办？他可一直是一个人！

say:15:1421504011:1.text: Vaun? Can't believe he wants in too. He doesn't stand a chance!
say:15:1421504011:1.source_cn: 瓦恩？他还想着参赛呢！回家玩木头锤子吧！

say:17:1421504012:1.text: You guys don't think Vaun has a shot?
say:17:1421504012:1.source_cn: 这个瓦恩……你们不是很看好他？

say:18:1421504013:1.text: Everyone in the village knows him... He's a craftsman who <style="highlight">can't make weapons</style>!
say:18:1421504013:1.source_cn: 他可是我们村有名的<style=highlight>造...

say:19:1421504014:1.text: Shh, Vaun's coming this way! Let's go sign up!
say:19:1421504014:1.source_cn: 不说了不说了，我看到瓦恩走过来了！走，报名去！

say:21:1421504015:1.source_cn: 锻魂大赛……听起来很有意思！

say:23:1421504016:1.text: I'm curious about that Vaun guy... Seems like he's being excluded...
say:23:1421504016:1.source_cn: 不过他们说的那个瓦恩是怎么回事……听起来像是被排挤了……

say:1:1421506001:1.text: Are you the envoy from the Lightbearer Empire?
say:1:1421506001:1.source_cn: 请问您就是那位耀光来的特使吗？
say:1:1421506001:1.male: Are you the envoy from the Lightbearer Empire?
say:1:1421506001:1.female: Are you the envoy from the Lightbearer Empire?

choice_prompt:2:1421506001.text: Are you the envoy from the Lightbearer Empire?
choice_prompt:2:1421506001.source_cn: 请问您就是那位耀光来的特使吗？
choice_prompt:2:1421506001.male: Are you the envoy from the Lightbearer Empire?
choice_prompt:2:1421506001.female: Are you the envoy from the Lightbearer Empire?

say:3:1421506002:1.text: I heard you have a familiar that carries a shield and wields a sword like a...
say:3:1421506002:1.source_cn: 我听说您身边有一位使魔，身披盾牌，手拿宝剑，像是一位……
say:3:1421506002:1.male: I heard you have a familiar that carries a shield and wields a sword like a...
say:3:1421506002:1.female: I heard you have a familiar that carries a shield and wields a sword like a...

say:7:1421506004:1.text: You're small, but you carry yourself with such poise! Could you be the knight they've been talking about?
say:7:1421506004:1.source_cn: ……这位小兄弟虽然个子不大，但却气度不凡，身上又有剑和...

say:8:1421506005:1.text: Hee-hee, I guess that's me! What can I do for you?
say:8:1421506005:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，他们说的应该就是我吧！不过你找我有什么事吗？

say:9:1421506006:1.text: Actually, I'm planning to sign up for the Forgemaster Competition this year, but I know I'm not quite champion material yet... It's all down to me.
say:9:1421506006:1.source_cn: 实不相瞒，我想报名参加新一届的锻魂大赛，但我知道以自己...

say:10:1421506007:1.text: I've always been on my own... It's been ages since I last sought someone else's opinions.
say:10:1421506007:1.source_cn: 我在追寻完美的锻艺的路上一个人走了太久……已经很久没有...

say:11:1421506008:1.text: The other craftsmen mentioned they consult their masters whenever they hit a problem. Have you always been working alone?
say:11:1421506008:1.source_cn: 我听说矮人工匠都会向自己的师父请教，一起攻克难题，你一...

say:12:1421506009:1.text: I've trained under several talented craftsmen and smiths before, but I never clicked with any of them... In the end, I left, and they gave up on me too.
say:12:1421506009:1.source_cn: 以前，我跟随好几位优秀的工匠都学过艺，但我们的理念始终...

say:13:1421506010:1.text: But recently, I had an epiphany! Before this, I was stuck in a craftsman's mindset, unable to grasp what truly defines a perfect weapon.
say:13:1421506010:1.source_cn: 可如今锻魂大赛马上就要开始了，我想通了一件事！以前的我...

say:14:1421506011:1.text: So, I could really use some guidance from a knight like Chippy. It'd be great to learn from someone who actually uses a weapon!
say:14:1421506011:1.source_cn: 如果我能向满满小兄弟这样的骑士拜师请教，了解武器使用者...

say:15:1421506012:1.text: Chippy uses a sword every day, but Chippy knows nothing about forging...
say:15:1421506012:1.source_cn: 满满确实每天都在用剑……可满满对锻造知道的也不多呀！要...

say:16:1421506013:1.text: Chippy thinks you should consult the magister instead! He is very knowledgeable and has seen all kinds of powerful weapons!
say:16:1421506013:1.source_cn: 比起请教满满，满满觉得你更应该请教主人！毕竟主人可是见...
say:16:1421506013:1.male: Chippy thinks you should consult the magister instead! He is very knowledgeable and has seen all kinds of powerful weapons!
say:16:1421506013:1.female: Chippy thinks you should consult the magister instead! She is very knowledgeable and has seen all kinds of powerful weapons!

say:19:1421506015:2.text: Stop overthinking! Now, you just need to sign up for the competition first. We'll do our best to help you!
say:19:1421506015:2.source_cn: 别纠结啦，总之我们会尽全力帮助你的！现在最要紧的第一件...

choice:18:1:2.text: We just want to help you.
choice:18:1:2.male: We just want to help you.
choice:18:1:2.female: We just want to help you.

say:0:1421507001:0.source_cn: 锻魂大赛的报名地点在这边。

say:2:1421509001:1.text: Hold on! We haven't signed up!

say:3:1421509002:1.text: You guys? I'm afraid the competition isn't open to outlanders.
say:3:1421509002:1.source_cn: 你们？外乡人可不能报名参赛。

say:4:1421509003:1.text: It's Vaun! He wants to sign up!

say:7:1421509004:1.text: I... I want to sign up!

say:8:1421509005:1.text: I see you've finally made up your mind. Have you found someone to guide you?
say:8:1421509005:1.source_cn: 瓦恩终于来了啊。找到人指导你了吗？

say:9:1421509006:1.text: This hamster here and his master... will guide me...
say:9:1421509006:1.source_cn: 这、这两位……仓鼠小兄弟和他的主人……
say:9:1421509006:1.male: This hamster here and his master... will guide me...
say:9:1421509006:1.female: This hamster here and his master... will guide me...

say:10:1421509007:1.text: Finding yourself some outlander guides? Interesting. You'll soon realize that "many hands make light work" doesn't always apply.
say:10:1421509007:1.source_cn: 请外乡人来指导……有意思。不过可不是指导的人越多就越好...

say:13:1421509009:1.text: The Forgemaster Competition this year officially begins!
say:13:1421509009:1.source_cn: 我宣布，本届锻魂大赛正式开始！

say:14:1421509010:1.text: Let me take you through the rules! The theme this year is... the sword!
say:14:1421509010:1.source_cn: 下面由我来介绍本次大赛的规则！本次大赛的主题是——锻剑！

say:15:1421509011:1.text: For the elimination stage, all contestants are required to forge a sword within the stipulated time using—listen carefully—the <style="highlight">material we provide</style>.
say:15:1421509011:1.source_cn: 淘汰赛阶段，所有选手都要在规定时间内使用主办方提供的材...

say:16:1421509012:1.text: If your sword meets the required standard, you'll advance to the finals!
say:16:1421509012:1.source_cn: 达到合格标准的优胜者将进入总决赛，参加最终的比试！

say:17:1421509013:1.text: Here's some good news—you can forge the sword at your own workshop! We'll deliver the material right to you!
say:17:1421509013:1.source_cn: 好消息是，参赛者可以使用自己的工坊锻造！而且主办方会将...

say:18:1421509014:1.text: Please note that anyone who violates the rules will be disqualified immediately!
say:18:1421509014:1.source_cn: 坏消息是，违反比赛规则的参赛者将会立即淘汰！

say:19:1421509015:1.text: You can now head back to your workshop and start working on your creation!
say:19:1421509015:1.source_cn: 现在请各位回到工坊，迎接你们的第一次考验吧！

say:0:1421511201:0.text: I must hurry! I've got to start before they do!
say:0:1421511201:0.source_cn: 抓紧时间！得抢在他们前面开始！

say:0:1421512001:0.text: Vaun, please take us to your workshop!
say:0:1421512001:0.source_cn: 瓦恩，带我们去你的工坊看看吧！

say:2:1421513001:1.source_cn: 瓦恩，这里就是你的工坊吗？

say:3:1421513002:1.text: There are so many unfinished pieces here! Some sword blanks over here, and some without hilts over there...
say:3:1421513002:1.source_cn: 好像没看到锻造好的武器呢……反倒是有这么多半成品！好多...

say:4:1421513003:1.source_cn: 为什么不把它们锻造完呢？

say:5:1421513004:1.text: They are far from perfection in my eyes, so I see no point in finishing them.
say:5:1421513004:1.source_cn: 它们远没有达到我心中完美的标准……没有锻造完成的必要。

say:6:1421513005:0.text: You're being too hard on yourself!

say:9:1421513006:1.text: Excuse me, is this Vaun's workshop? I'm here to deliver the material for the first round.
say:9:1421513006:1.source_cn: 打扰一下，这里是瓦恩的工坊吗？我来送淘汰赛第一阶段的材料。

say:11:1421513007:1.text: First round? Does that mean there's a second round?
say:11:1421513007:1.source_cn: 第一阶段，这么说还有第二阶段？

say:12:1421513008:1.text: You're quick to catch on! Anyway, I'd suggest you focus on the first round and make sure you stay in the competition.
say:12:1421513008:1.source_cn: 你理解的没错！不过还是先过关第一阶段再考虑第二阶段的事...

say:13:1421513009:1.text: For the first round, you need to forge a sword blade using the material I brought!
say:13:1421513009:1.source_cn: 第一阶段的目标是，使用我提供的材料锻造质量达标的剑刃！

say:14:1421513010:1.text: The material might not be as... ready to use as you expect, but I'm sure you'll figure out how to <style="highlight">work with it</style>! I'll go inform the other contestants now!
say:14:1421513010:1.source_cn: 材料可能不像你们想的那样……便捷，但我相信你们有办法<...

say:17:1421513012:0.text: W—What on earth is this? This is just scrap!
say:17:1421513012:0.source_cn: 这、这哪是什么材料，这就是块废材嘛！

say:18:1421513013:0.text: Every time I forge a sword, I always use the best materials I can find... Even so, I'm still not satisfied with the result...
say:18:1421513013:0.source_cn: 以往锻剑的时候，我都会用能找到的最好的材料去锻造……即...

say:19:1421513014:2.text: Look at this—it's full of impurities, and its toughness is way below par! I can't use this scrap to forge a sword!
say:19:1421513014:2.source_cn: 这材料里混杂了这么多杂质，韧性、纯度都不达标！这样的材...

choice_prompt:20:1421513014.text: Look at this—it's full of impurities, and its toughness is way below par! I can't use this scrap to forge a sword!
choice_prompt:20:1421513014.source_cn: 这材料里混杂了这么多杂质，韧性、纯度都不达标！这样的材料怎么能拿来锻剑！

say:21:1421513015:1.text: Indeed... but it's only because I'm pursuing perfection! No one, not even the masters I once learned from, understands my vision! Over time, I've grown distant from them...
say:21:1421513015:1.source_cn: 是这样……因为我想追求极致的锻艺，锻造出完美的作品！可...
say:21:1421513015:1.male: Indeed... but it's only because I'm pursuing perfection! No one, not even the masters I once learned from, understands my vision! Over time, I've grown distant from them...
say:21:1421513015:1.female: Indeed... but it's only because I'm pursuing perfection! No one, not even the masters I once learned from, understands my vision! Over time, I've grown distant from them...

choice_prompt:22:1421513015.text: Indeed... but it's only because I'm pursuing perfection! No one, not even the masters I once learned from, understands my vision! Over time, I've grown distant from them...
choice_prompt:22:1421513015.source_cn: 是这样……因为我想追求极致的锻艺，锻造出完美的作品！可其他人——哪怕是我跟随学艺的老师都不理解我的想法！我也和他们渐行渐远……
choice_prompt:22:1421513015.male: Indeed... but it's only because I'm pursuing perfection! No one, not even the masters I once learned from, understands my vision! Over time, I've grown distant from them...
choice_prompt:22:1421513015.female: Indeed... but it's only because I'm pursuing perfection! No one, not even the masters I once learned from, understands my vision! Over time, I've grown distant from them...

say:23:1421513016:2.text: Such profound words... Chippy thinks the magister is trying to say that a true craftsman is someone who can make imperfect things perfect!
say:23:1421513016:2.source_cn: 好深奥的话……满满觉得，主人是在说，能让不完美的东西变...
say:23:1421513016:2.male: Such profound words... Chippy thinks the magister is trying to say that a true craftsman is someone who can make imperfect things perfect!
say:23:1421513016:2.female: Such profound words... Chippy thinks the magister is trying to say that a true craftsman is someone who can make imperfect things perfect!

say:24:1421513017:1.text: Making imperfect things perfect... Do you think those swords have the potential to be perfect? Seems like I was hasty to give up on them...
say:24:1421513017:1.source_cn: 让不完美的东西变得完美……您觉得那些剑都有变得完美的可...
say:24:1421513017:1.male: Making imperfect things perfect... Do you think those swords have the potential to be perfect? Seems like I was hasty to give up on them...
say:24:1421513017:1.female: Making imperfect things perfect... Do you think those swords have the potential to be perfect? Seems like I was hasty to give up on them...

say:26:1421513019:1.text: I think I know how to pass the first round.
say:26:1421513019:1.source_cn: 我想我明白怎么通过第一阶段的考验了。
say:26:1421513019:1.male: I think I know how to pass the first round.
say:26:1421513019:1.female: I think I know how to pass the first round.

say:27:1421513020:1.text: Eh? Why is Chippy still confused?
say:27:1421513020:1.source_cn: 哎，满满还是一头雾水呢？

say:28:1421513021:1.text: I'm not sure if I'll succeed, but I'll try to extract pure iron from this scrap!
say:28:1421513021:1.source_cn: 虽然不知道有多少把握，但我想试着从这块废材中冶炼出精铁！

say:31:1421513023:1.text: This material is heavy enough, and there's iron in it. Let me think...
say:31:1421513023:1.source_cn: 这块材料质量是足够的，里面也的确有铁，我想想……

say:32:1421513024:1.text: This is something I learned when I was a novice—I can use acid to remove the impurities, and then add charcoal for the reaction. For the flux... fluorite would be perfect!
say:32:1421513024:1.source_cn: 我刚做工匠那会儿学过，先用酸液分离部分表面杂质，再加入...

say:33:1421513025:1.text: I'll gather everything I need and come up with a plan!
say:33:1421513025:1.source_cn: 我找找这些材料，再写个可行的操作法子！

choice:22:0:1.source_cn: 它们原本都有成为<style=stress>完美的剑</style>的可能

choice:20:0:1.source_cn: 以往那些剑都没有被你锻完

choice:20:1:2.text: You gave up on your swords.
choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 以往那些剑都被你放弃了
choice:20:1:2.male: You gave up on your swords.
choice:20:1:2.female: You gave up on your swords.

say:2:1421516001:1.text: You did it! It's pure iron!
say:2:1421516001:1.source_cn: 成功啦！真的提炼出了看起来品质很好的精铁！

choice_prompt:3:1421516001.text: You did it! It's pure iron!
choice_prompt:3:1421516001.source_cn: 成功啦！真的提炼出了看起来品质很好的精铁！

say:4:1421516002:1.text: I wouldn't call it perfect... But this time, I won't give up halfway!
say:4:1421516002:1.source_cn: 虽然尽了全力，但它在我看来并不算完美……不过这次我不会...

say:5:1421516003:1.text: Next comes forging, quenching, and polishing, which will test my fundamentals and patience. These steps take time, and I'll be working alone...
say:5:1421516003:1.source_cn: 接下来锻造、淬火、打磨这些步骤考验的是我身为工匠的基本...

say:6:1421516004:1.text: You guys must be tired from all the traveling. Please take a break.
say:6:1421516004:1.source_cn: 你们远道而来，今天又一直为我奔波，还请先回去休息吧！

say:7:1421516005:1.source_cn: 那我们等明天来看你的成果！

choice:3:0:1.text: Are you happy with it, Vaun?
choice:3:0:1.male: Are you happy with it, Vaun?
choice:3:0:1.female: Are you happy with it, Vaun?

say:0:1421517001:0.text: It's still early. Let's see how the other contestants are doing!
say:0:1421517001:0.source_cn: 时间还早，我们去看看其他参加比赛的人的情况吧！

say:2:1421519001:1.text: What's going on here? Everyone looks pretty worked up.
say:2:1421519001:1.source_cn: 这里发生什么啦，大家看起来很……激动的样子？

say:3:1421519002:1.text: Lacy, we demand an explanation! Did you guys pocket the funds? The material is terrible!
say:3:1421519002:1.source_cn: 拉齐，能不能给个说法！大赛的经费是不是被你们私吞了！怎...

say:6:1421519003:1.text: The rule says so! Everyone gets the same thing!
say:6:1421519003:1.source_cn: 都说了这是比赛规则！每个人都是一样的！

say:7:1421519004:1.text: I don't care! What if you're giving better materials to the others? If you don't get something better for me, I'm out!
say:7:1421519004:1.source_cn: 我不管！谁知道你有没有给其他人好材料！不给我换材料我就退赛！

say:2:1421521001:0.text: It's a real mess here... What happened?
say:2:1421521001:0.source_cn: 怎么这里在吵架呀……发生什么了吗？

say:3:1421521002:1.text: I've been disqualified because the host said I broke a rule!
say:3:1421521002:1.source_cn: 这个主持人说我违反了比赛规则……我的参赛资格被取消了！

say:6:1421521003:1.text: Our investigation confirms that you didn't use the material we provided, but the pig iron you prepared yourself...
say:6:1421521003:1.source_cn: 经过调查，你使用的材料确实不是我们提供的，而是自己准备...

say:7:1421521004:1.text: What's wrong with that? The sword has to meet the standard, right? I can't do that with that junk you gave me!
say:7:1421521004:1.source_cn: 我用点好材料有什么不对！还不是为了达到你们说的合格标准...

say:9:1421521006:1.text: This rule is ridiculous! If you don't know how to run the competition, just let me take over!
say:9:1421521006:1.source_cn: 你们定的规则根本就不合理！这比赛不如换我来办！……

say:3:1421522001:1.text: This competition is so chaotic! Hopefully, Vaun can make it to the second round.
say:3:1421522001:1.source_cn: 真是多灾多难的比赛！希望瓦恩能成功吧！

say:4:1421522002:1.text: What an eventful day it's been! Let's call it a day and visit Vaun tomorrow.
say:4:1421522002:1.source_cn: 今天发生了好多事！我们好好休息一下，明天去找瓦恩吧！

say:0:1421525001:0.text: Sounds like Vaun still has his nose to the grindstone... Did he work through the night?
say:0:1421525001:0.source_cn: 瓦恩还在忙活……他是敲打了一整晚吗？

say:2:1421526001:1.source_cn: 瓦恩，我们来看看你的进展！

say:3:1421526002:1.text: Wow, this blade looks so sharp! Chippy can't believe it's made from that scrap. It's already perfect!
say:3:1421526002:1.source_cn: 哇，好锋利的宝剑！真想不到这是那块材料锻出来的剑！满满...

say:4:1421526003:1.text: But I still see room for improvement...

choice_prompt:5:1421526003.text: But I still see room for improvement...

say:6:1421526004:1.text: Hear that? The magister and Chippy are on the same page! You can trust our judgment!
say:6:1421526004:1.source_cn: 看！主人都发话啦！满满和主人两个人的判断肯定没问题！
say:6:1421526004:1.male: Hear that? The magister and Chippy are on the same page! You can trust our judgment!
say:6:1421526004:1.female: Hear that? The magister and Chippy are on the same page! You can trust our judgment!

say:9:1421526006:1.text: Time's up anyway! The first round of the elimination stage is officially over!
say:9:1421526006:1.source_cn: 再不舍得停手也该停啦！淘汰赛第一阶段正式结束！

say:10:1421526007:1.text: Let me see this blade... Not bad! You nailed it!
say:10:1421526007:1.source_cn: 我来看看这把剑胚……不错，看来你们领悟了主办方的苦心！

say:11:1421526008:1.source_cn: 我宣布，瓦恩正式通过第一阶段的考验！

say:12:1421526009:1.text: See these wooded pieces? They are the materials for the next round.
say:12:1421526009:1.source_cn: 下面，我将发放下一阶段的材料——也就是这些木料。

say:13:1421526010:1.text: You must use these to craft the hilt for your sword. After the first round, I'm sure all of you have got the hang of things.
say:13:1421526010:1.source_cn: 参赛者需要使用主办方提供的木料制作并安装剑柄。相信你们...

say:15:1421526011:0.text: The wood... looks pretty rough and far from sturdy...
say:15:1421526011:0.source_cn: 看起来破破烂烂的……木质很疏松呢……

say:16:1421526012:0.text: Please carry on with your work. Once you're done, you can head back to the competition site to submit your sword. Good luck! I'm rooting for you!
say:16:1421526012:0.source_cn: 那么请继续准备比赛吧。剑柄安装完成后，请前往参赛场地提...

say:19:1421526013:0.text: With the experience from the first round, Chippy thinks this round is all about digging for diamonds in the rough... Right?
say:19:1421526013:0.source_cn: 有了上一次的经验，这次又是在考验我们能不能从这些木料中...

say:20:1421526014:1.text: Yes. This type of wood has a porous outer layer but an incredibly sturdy core. Let me try removing the outer part...
say:20:1421526014:1.source_cn: 的确，这种铁藜木虽然边材疏松，但心材却格外坚硬，我试着...

narration:1:1421527001:0.text: Vaun spends some time processing the wood...
narration:1:1421527001:0.male: Vaun spends some time processing the wood...
narration:1:1421527001:0.female: Vaun spends some time processing the wood...

say:2:1421528001:1.text: So, that's the good part we can use! But... it's so tiny.
say:2:1421528001:1.source_cn: 剩下的材料就是可以做剑柄的材料了嘛！可是……好小！

say:3:1421528002:1.text: Is it really enough for the hilt?
say:3:1421528002:1.source_cn: 这么小的一块木头，真能做成剑柄吗？

say:4:1421528003:1.text: It is, as long as I don't make any mistakes...
say:4:1421528003:1.source_cn: 不出任何错的前提下，勉强够用……

say:5:1421528004:1.text: Still, I won't have any room to carve patterns on the hilt...
say:5:1421528004:1.source_cn: 可是这样我要怎么雕刻剑柄的造型呢……我原本想在剑柄上做...

say:6:1421528005:1.text: Carving?! Chippy thinks there isn't enough wood for that!
say:6:1421528005:1.source_cn: 这样小的木头上还要做雕刻？！满满觉得这样材料会不够的！

say:7:1421528006:1.text: I can do hollow carving... but it'll make the hilt lighter...
say:7:1421528006:1.source_cn: 如果是镂空雕刻的话，我可以用现有的材料完成……只是剑柄...

say:8:1421528007:1.text: The sword is a weapon. To Chippy, practicality and comfort matter the most!
say:8:1421528007:1.source_cn: 满满觉得剑作为武器，最重要的是实用性！是作为武器的手感！

say:9:1421528008:1.text: Chippy thinks it's unwise to sacrifice practicality for looks!
say:9:1421528008:1.source_cn: 如果为了美观而舍弃实用性……满满不认可这种做法！

say:10:1421528009:1.text: But carving is an important part of craftsmanship. Since this is a competition, I have to showcase my carving skills to the judges...
say:10:1421528009:1.source_cn: 可雕刻是显示工匠技术的重要一环，毕竟这是比赛，我不得不...

say:11:1421528010:1.text: The patterns we carve reflect our sense of aesthetics... If all the swords look the same, how are the judges supposed to decide the winning sword?
say:11:1421528010:1.source_cn: 雕刻还代表了一个工匠的审美……如果大家的作品都一模一样...

say:12:1421528011:1.text: Chippy... Chippy isn't good with words, but you said you wanted to see things from the user's perspective when you approached us!
say:12:1421528011:1.source_cn: 满满……满满说不过你！可满满记得你一开始请我们帮忙的时...

say:13:1421528012:1.text: The sword is only truly perfect when its user thinks so!
say:13:1421528012:1.source_cn: 满满觉得，只有使用者觉得这把剑完美！它才是真的完美的武器！

say:14:1421528013:1.text: As a user, Chippy would always prefer a practical sword over a beautiful one!
say:14:1421528013:1.source_cn: 满满说的都是自己作为使用者真实的感受！满满更喜欢实用的...

say:15:1421528014:1.text: Chippy likes a weapon with a soul!
say:15:1421528014:1.source_cn: 满满喜欢的是有灵魂的武器！

say:16:1421528015:1.text: I get it now. I totally understand how you feel, Chippy.
say:16:1421528015:1.source_cn: ……我明白了。我完全理解满满你的感受了。

say:17:1421528016:1.text: Have you decided not to carve the hilt?
say:17:1421528016:1.source_cn: 你放弃在剑柄上雕刻的想法啦！

say:18:1421528017:1.text: After taking a closer look at the wood, I decided to do some hollow carving at the end of the hilt...
say:18:1421528017:1.source_cn: 我又看了一下这块木料……还是决定在握柄的尾端做一些镂空...

say:19:1421528018:1.text: You didn't listen to what I said at all...
say:19:1421528018:1.source_cn: 我说的你根本没听进去嘛……

say:20:1421528019:1.text: It is up to the user who holds the weapon in their hand to judge whether it's perfect, not the craftsman or the public...
say:20:1421528019:1.source_cn: 剑是否完美，不取决于锻造它的工匠，也不取决于他人的眼光...

say:22:1421528020:1.text: Chippy—I mean, Master Chippy—it's precisely because of your advice that I decided to carve.
say:22:1421528020:1.source_cn: 正因为尊重满满小兄弟……不，是满满师父的感受，我才决定...

say:23:1421528021:1.text: I just gave this piece of ironwood a feel and noticed it was denser, and therefore heavier, than the usual hilt wood.
say:23:1421528021:1.source_cn: 我刚才掂量了一下这块铁藜木的重量，发现它比常用作剑柄的...

say:24:1421528022:1.text: For the sake of practicality, I have to reduce its weight with some hollow carving...
say:24:1421528022:1.source_cn: 出于实用性的考虑，为了让使用者手感更加舒适，我必须通过...

say:25:1421528023:1.text: I see! Chippy's pleased to hear that!
say:25:1421528023:1.source_cn: 原来是这样！主人，不知道为什么，满满突然觉得好高兴！
say:25:1421528023:1.male: I see! Chippy's pleased to hear that!
say:25:1421528023:1.female: I see! Chippy's pleased to hear that!

choice_prompt:26:1421528023.text: I see! Chippy's pleased to hear that!
choice_prompt:26:1421528023.source_cn: 原来是这样！主人，不知道为什么，满满突然觉得好高兴！
choice_prompt:26:1421528023.male: I see! Chippy's pleased to hear that!
choice_prompt:26:1421528023.female: I see! Chippy's pleased to hear that!

say:27:1421528024:2.text: Let's give Vaun some time to tie up the loose ends!
say:27:1421528024:2.source_cn: 我们给瓦恩留点时间，让他把剩下的工作完成吧！

choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 瓦恩对锻造这门手艺感悟更深了

narration:0:1421529001:1.text: Meticulously, Vaun finishes attaching the hilt to the sword and carving on it...
narration:0:1421529001:1.male: Meticulously, Vaun finishes attaching the hilt to the sword and carving on it...
narration:0:1421529001:1.female: Meticulously, Vaun finishes attaching the hilt to the sword and carving on it...

say:0:1421530001:0.text: The sword's finally ready! Let's submit it!
say:0:1421530001:0.source_cn: 花了不少时间，该去参赛场地提交作品啦！

say:0:1421531001:0.text: I can sense the tension in the air here...
say:0:1421531001:0.source_cn: 这里的气氛怎么有些低迷……

say:2:1421533001:1.source_cn: 大家为什么心情这么低落呀？

say:3:1421533002:1.text: The host said my sword didn't meet the standard, and I got eliminated! This is so unfair!
say:3:1421533002:1.source_cn: 主持人说我没达到合格的要求，我被淘汰了！这不是故意刁难人嘛！

say:4:1421533003:1.text: Who'd have thought that such a tiny piece of wood could be so heavy?!
say:4:1421533003:1.source_cn: 就那么一小块能用的材料，谁能想到它做成握柄后那么重呢！

say:5:1421533004:1.text: Maybe you could have tried carving to reduce the weight...
say:5:1421533004:1.source_cn: 或许能通过雕刻减轻一些重量……

say:6:1421533005:1.text: Don't even mention it! My master and I couldn't agree on the carving issue, and things almost got physical!
say:6:1421533005:1.source_cn: 别提了！我师父和师父的师父因为要不要雕刻这事吵了半天，...

say:7:1421533006:1.text: In the end, I didn't even have enough time to do the actual work, so I had to settle for this sloppy work!
say:7:1421533006:1.source_cn: 最后留给我干活的时间都不够了，我就只能这样交上去了！

say:8:1421533007:1.text: I should have just done this on my own...
say:8:1421533007:1.source_cn: 早知道还不如我一个人……

say:1:1421534001:1.text: We're here to submit our work!

say:2:1421534002:1.text: You're the last one! Let me take a look at Vaun's work... The sword has a sharp and sleek edge! The carving on the hilt is exquisitely done with a rustic and elegant style. Most importantly, the weight is perfectly balanced...
say:2:1421534002:1.source_cn: 就差你们了！我来看看瓦恩的作品——剑锋飒沓锐利！剑柄雕...

say:3:1421534003:1.text: Vaun, this is a real breakthrough for you.
say:3:1421534003:1.source_cn: 瓦恩，看来你真的突破了你自己。

say:4:1421534004:1.text: You and Teota are the only contestants who passed the second round!
say:4:1421534004:1.source_cn: 我宣布，你和铁哥达是唯二通过淘汰赛考验的工匠。

say:6:1421534006:1.text: He's Ironbeard's apprentice... I didn't realize he was one of the contestants.
say:6:1421534006:1.source_cn: 是铁须的徒弟……原来他也参加这次的锻魂大赛了。

say:7:1421534007:1.text: Teota and Vaun, the finals will decide the champion between the two of you!
say:7:1421534007:1.source_cn: 铁哥达和瓦恩，本届锻魂大赛的冠军将通过接下来的最终比试...

say:10:1421534008:1.text: Vaun?! I never thought you'd be my final opponent.
say:10:1421534008:1.source_cn: 瓦恩？！真没想到最后的对手是你。

say:11:1421534009:1.text: Hey, Teota... And this gentleman next to you is...
say:11:1421534009:1.source_cn: 铁哥达……还有你身边这是……

say:12:1421534010:1.text: This is my mercenary friend, Slagel. He took a long boat ride to Brimstone Village just to help me test my sword...
say:12:1421534010:1.source_cn: 这是我在外认识的佣兵朋友斯拉格，他为了帮我试剑特意坐很...

say:13:1421534011:1.text: My master's advice has helped me a great deal in this competition...
say:13:1421534011:1.source_cn: 这次比赛里，师父的建议帮了我很多……

say:14:1421534012:1.text: But in the end, it was my determination to forge the perfect weapon for Slagel that helped me pass this round!
say:14:1421534012:1.source_cn: 但最终是为斯拉格锻造一把趁手的好武器的决心让我通过了考验！

say:15:1421534013:1.text: Teota did a great job! It's almost too big to be called a sword!

say:17:1421534014:1.text: Bring it on in the finals, Vaun! I won't back down!
say:17:1421534014:1.source_cn: 最终比试……尽管来吧，我可不会怕你！

say:19:1421534015:1.text: In the finals, two of our team members will duel using the swords you forge. The weapon of the winner will be crowned the champion!
say:19:1421534015:1.source_cn: 最终比试是对你们锻造的武器进行实战测试，将会有两名工作...

say:21:1421534016:1.text: Chippy's up for the duel! I want to fight with Vaun's sword!
say:21:1421534016:1.source_cn: 满满想要报名参赛！我想用瓦恩锻造的剑战斗！

say:23:1421534017:1.text: Hamster combat? Is this some sort of hamster fight club? Whatever! I'll fight you!

say:24:1421534018:1.text: I see we have some volunteers here. This is going to be an exciting match!
say:24:1421534018:1.source_cn: 你们想亲自来吗……好吧。真是一场激昂澎湃的决战！

say:26:1421534019:1.text: Remember, this match isn't about your combat skills, but the weapon you wield.
say:26:1421534019:1.source_cn: 记住，比拼的不是你们的战斗技巧，而是你们手中的武器。

say:27:1421534020:1.source_cn: 现在我宣布，最终比试正式开始！

say:4:1421535001:1.text: Yay! Chippy won! Vaun is the champion!
say:4:1421535001:1.source_cn: 耶！满满赢了！瓦恩是冠军！

say:5:1421535002:1.text: I am... the champion... of the Forgemaster Competition? Never in my wildest dreams did I imagine this...
say:5:1421535002:1.source_cn: 我是……冠军……锻魂大赛的冠军……我想都不敢想……

say:6:1421535003:1.text: Vaun... Although Chippy still loves his own sword the most, your sword was perfect just now!
say:6:1421535003:1.source_cn: 瓦恩……虽然满满还是最喜欢自己的剑，但刚刚战斗的时候，...

say:7:1421535004:1.text: Thank you so much, my masters, and of course, Hammie!
say:7:1421535004:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们……谢谢我的两位师父和漫漫的帮助！

say:8:1421535005:1.text: All this time, I've been working hard to forge the most perfect weapon in the world... But my standards of perfection have become so strict over time that the pressure was starting to crush me!
say:8:1421535005:1.source_cn: 一直以来，我都在追寻技艺的极致，想用这双手锻造出世界上...

say:9:1421535006:1.text: Before this, I didn't even have a single finished piece of work to my name!
say:9:1421535006:1.source_cn: 结果你们也知道，遇见你们之前，我连一把像样的武器都没有锻成！

say:10:1421535007:1.text: Thanks to you, I came to realize that it's the user who decides whether a weapon is perfect... When I saw Master Chippy fighting with my sword just now, my heart was filled with joy...
say:10:1421535007:1.source_cn: 是你们告诉我，完美与否取决于使用者感受……刚才，我看到...

say:11:1421535008:1.text: The user's satisfaction means everything, and my earlier obsession now feels meaningless...
say:11:1421535008:1.source_cn: 你们让我意识到，对完美的武器的坚持，比起看到使用武器的...

say:12:1421535009:1.text: I believe I've gained something even more valuable than the trophy from this competition...
say:12:1421535009:1.source_cn: 我觉得，比冠军更重要的东西，我在锻魂大赛的过程中已经得...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1421508001:.text: Everyone, the registration is closing soon!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1421508001:.source_cn: 锻魂大赛报名即将截止！
